Oxalis corniculata , Procumbent Yellow-sorrel/Sleeping Beauty, locally known as 'Taingang Daga' in the Philippines (Mouse ears)

Introduced, warm season herb. Branches are erect or ascending, sometimes creeping, to 30 cm long, sparsely to densely hairy, with spreading hairs. Roots are fibrous and branching, sometimes with a tap
